## Observed release-gate blocker
PR #298 head `497f4c36c78920363bb72e54280410dbec902eac`, [Node26 job123273116519](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-changelog/actions/runs/40817205513/job/123273116519), finished2026-10-29 05:15 UTC:
-948 tests;947 passed;1 failed.
-`test/help-parser-contract.test.ts:100`: “help contract covers every standalone command dispatched by main”.
-Actual registered test-map commands: audit/contracts/corrections/upgrades.
-Expected source-dispatched commands additionally include drift.
-The same gate reports99.97% branch coverage against100%; `src/cli.ts`99.65%, new agent-contract modules100%. The precise uncovered CLI branch is not established from this log alone.

## Static cause and reproduction
The [test's commands map](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-changelog/blob/497f4c36c78920363bb72e54280410dbec902eac/test/help-parser-contract.test.ts#L92-L105) registers existing subcommand parsers but omits `src/agent-contract-command.ts`. [CLI main](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-changelog/blob/497f4c36c78920363bb72e54280410dbec902eac/src/cli.ts) now dispatches `drift`; its AST-derived invariant correctly detects the missing test-contract entry.

On an isolated checkout with declared dependencies, run:
`node --test --test-name-pattern="help contract covers every standalone command dispatched by main" test/help-parser-contract.test.ts`
Then run the unchanged full release gates to cover the CLI branch gap. The failure above is hosted evidence; the focused command was not independently rerun in this review.

## Expected / impact / limits
The [canonical drift feature](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-changelog/blob/497f4c36c78920363bb72e54280410dbec902eac/.agents/pm/features/pmc-agent-contract-drift.toon) requires agent-first host/standalone/SDK parity and full release gates. Every dispatched standalone command should participate in the help/parser contract matrix, and full gates must remain100%. This is a test/coverage integration blocker, not evidence that drift projections are incorrect or that the help output omits drift. Independent bounded projection checks passed separately; lifecycle success does not imply the failed full gate passed.

## Acceptance
- Add drift to the parser/help contract matrix using the same source-derived flags mechanism; retain the invariant rather than removing/weakening it.
- Cover all newly added CLI dispatch/error paths required by the existing100% thresholds; inspect the real uncovered branch rather than assuming it shares this cause.
- Verify exact new-head Node22/26 npm/Bun full gates and retain counts/links; don't reuse earlier-head or lifecycle-only success.
- Preserve existing command behavior, omissions and error remedies.

All-status issues/PRs and canonical feature inspected. Existing #295 concerns a different older linked-test trust-admission refusal and is not this failure. No implementation or trust settings changed during review.
